en: Oh good, a scav. I'm Tajra, ex-Palatine. Retired. C'mere, you're gonna help me with something.
What do you want?
You make too much noise.
Saw you from a mile away.
Why're you bothering me?
We gotta talk.
Let's talk.
Need to talk to you.
Got anything to trade?
I want to trade.
Got something to trade?
You came to the right place.
Always got something.
Well I'm not going anywhere, am I.
Sure, don't see why not.
Try not to be a target out there.
Go on, now.
You have to go, so go.
Got a request?
Got work for me?
Need something from me?
You're good to move.
We've cleared that area for you.
Sasha and I took care of your problem.
You're an ex-Palatine, then?
I've served the Palatines 25 years. You'd think they'd give me a better pension. Ha! It's like after I lost my leg, I became like dirt to them.
I'm pretty sure the old, pre-War army wouldn't have been so ungrateful to its soldiers. Well, at least I have Sasha. He's always treated me right, that boy.
How are you finding the new place?
It's been good, scav. Acolytes will drop by every now and then, hell, maybe a bit too often for my taste, but... There's been more bad days than good days, so I let them in.
And this is a good spot for hunting... Although sometimes a pesky squatter will come asking for a handout. Well, it's fun to scare them away, I suppose.
How'd you lose that leg?
You're not afraid to ask about that stuff, huh? But come on, now. You're a scav, you've seen some shit. Isn't it more fun to use your imagination?
Didn't know they expelled their soldiers.
Expel? No, no. Honorably discharged. They offered me an officer post, sitting behind a desk in Arcadia, barking orders, warm meals every day. Sounded like hell, so I left.
I know it doesn't seem like it now, but if you'd seen me in my heyday... Well, you wouldn't have; I'd be lying in the bushes... Knife between my teeth...
Unseen, but ready. Those were the days... Why'd anyone choose a bit of comfort over the thrill of getting kills?
Okay. Mutant bite.
I said to use your imagination, not to come up with the single most trivial, boring thing that Zalesye has to offer.
You complained about a situation that you chose and bragged about.
Yeah, so? Life's full of contradictions, boy. Just because they offered me the post, doesn't mean they shouldn't help this old hag out a little more when she made her choice.
About that Palatine thing...
Yeah?
Let me guess the leg thing again.
Sure, take a stab at it.
Gotta go.
Stepped on a landmine.
Are those still around? I'd think you scavs would've already stepped on every single one.
Fell into Lake Pavlie.
You know, I did once, actually. It was a shallow bit, thankfully. My gear protected me, came out unscathed, my squadmates bullied me about it for a while.
Spontaneous combustion.
Hmm, that's too dry. Work an Aspect into it or something.
Cut it off yourself, just to feel something.
I see the Mist has started to corrode your brain a little bit. Might want to replace that gas mask, boy.
Got mistaken for a corpse, Mudlarks hacked it off.
You're a cheeky fuck, aren't you? Though I'll be the first to admit, that's becoming a more likely reality by the day! Ha!
Good guess, but no cigar.
I would never turn down an offer like that.
Well, you say that, young man, but it's not like you don't have goals of your own. I've worked with many scavs... Vultures, over the years. You're always looking at those train tracks...
Ooohh, that look you just gave. Looks like I'm spot on.
Look, I've served the military a long, long time, seen many leaders come and go. I just like to hunt and shoot things, don't want any real responsibilities, thank you very much.
Why are you living alone like this?

Why, because I'm a hunter, of course. I've lived in this shitty little shack since my retirement, chasing down Mutants for food every day. It's fun stuff, hell, you've done it before for sure, so I know you know.
But lately, the Mist's been creeping in, attracting more and more of those creatures... Bigger ones, too. I need to move soon. Every day I've been cutting it a little closer...
About something else.
Never mind; I have to go.

Yeah, could use a scav. As you can see, I'm low-mobility and this place isn't safe to live in anymore... I heard of a good spot, near the Church, but there's a Bandit camp nearby. An old squadmate's promised to help me take them out, but...
I refuse to ask dear Sasha to snipe them all alone. So I thought I'd hire you, so you two can team up to clear that Bandit camp, and then I'll move.
Does this sound like a job you'd be interested in?
I'll do it, sure. Just gotta have a plan.
Good, good. Meet up with Sasha, work something out. You can trust him. I think he's around... Here, let me mark that down for you...
Me and a sniper? An entire camp? Too dangerous.
Listen, I'm not doing it myself because I'm in this rickety thing. Healthy young man like you should have a breezy time handlin' some punks with Sasha by your side.
Where do I meet your escort, again?
Show me your map. Here, I've marked the spot where Sasha should've set up.
Where's this camp we're about to hit?
Oh, Sasha should be able to show you that. Don't worry, I'm sure you two will get along.
A retired Palatine can't handle a few Bandits?
Ugh... It's painful to admit this, but... As you can see, I'm past my prime. I'm afraid I can't handle those losers anymore... Not after I lost the leg.
Why not move somewhere with no Bandits?
I've got to stay closer to the Church, so those Acolytes can help me with my routine. I've been needing more and more help, and... I'm a bit scared, I suppose.
Plenty of spots for squatters near the Church...
Well, yes, but I'd also like to be able to keep hunting, on the good days. Don't want my independent lifestyle to be fully gone.
So that's why... It needs to be a specific place. And there's Bandits in the way. And they just need to die.
I don't have any more questions.
Then it sounds like you're good to go. Don't keep Sasha waiting, now.
Have you met with Sasha yet?
Not yet.
Don't keep him waiting. He might get confident and open fire on the camp all alone. Whatever happens next, you can be sure you'll lose your reward.
Had some questions first.
Well, don't beat around the bush.
Hah! So you did. How was working with my boy? I'm sure y'all wiped them out easily.
Thanks for the help, scav. Now I can finally move to a better place and live out the rest of my days with a little bit of peace of mind... Maybe some company, too.
And what do I get?
Oh, right, right. Been a bit forgetful, heh. Here you go, scav. I'll be on the move now... If you're ever near the Church, do pay a visit, huh?
Sasha's good backup. He'd be a decent Vulture.
Ha ha, no, no, I bet he would hate it. Wandering the wastes would mess up his shirt.
Here; your reward. If you're near the Church sometime, do drop by.
